meta.revisionPolicy: WDI revises history freely at every update: a new vintage can change any past value. Raw dumps keep every vintage.
meta.coverage: GDP, GNI, expenditure, value added by sector, savings and natural-resource rents (WDI)
meta.note: Values as published in WDI for India, unrounded. Each series is one WDI indicator; its code is the series name. Series start and end in different years; the axis spans the widest.
